title: Will DaVita's Q3 Earnings Reflect Improving Treatment Growth Trends?
author: Na
description: DaVita is expected to report Q3 2026 results on October 29 with EPS projected to rise 50.6% YoY to $3.78 and revenues growing 3.2% to $3.53B. Improving treatment volumes and favorable calendar effects should support growth, while cost controls and kidney care gains may offset reimbursement pressures. However, weak commercial payor mix and revenue per treatment pressures remain concerns.

author: Zacks.Com
description: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of $3.00 per share (up 15.4% YoY) and revenues of $3.10 billion (up 10% YoY), both beating consensus estimates. The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $12.065-$12.105 billion and adjusted EPS outlook to $11.25-$11.35. Despite strong results, DGX shares fell 1.6% in pre-market trading.
